   2→
   3→Preparation only. Codex directly reread approved TP-MA-07 v2.0 body children

   7→## Assessments
   8→
   9→Define endpoint measurement methods, named instruments and versions, evaluator
  10→roles/training, specimen type/volume/handling, relevant timing and qualifications.
  11→Do not substitute a generic “per SOA” paragraph for how a measurement is obtained.
  12→Conversely, bind timing to the actual SOA rather than create conflicting duplicates.
  13→Eligibility assessments, efficacy assessments and safety monitoring have distinct
  14→purposes even when they share a procedure.
  15→
  16→Body 574–575 carries specimens and generic special assays: neither constitutes a
  17→complete immunogenicity strategy. Applicable PK/PD/E-R and immunogenicity need
  18→their own linked endpoints, samples, timing and analysis requirements. Future-use
  19→specimens are distinct from samples required by the current study.
  20→
  21→IRC (586–589) is conditional. RECIST 1.1, oncology imaging and CD transfer are
  22→examples, not universal endpoint adjudication methods. Do not conflate an IRC
  23→with a safety/data monitoring committee. Parent content and these unheaded
  24→obligations remain covered despite leaf counting.
  25→
  26→## Event content and template issues
  27→
  28→- AE definition, collection interval, TEAE derivation, severity, seriousness,
  29→  causality, expectedness, recording and follow-up are distinct obligations.
  30→- Source 599 oncology progression exception cannot be copied to unrelated
  31→  indications. Source 602 CTCAE 5.0 is a versioned selection requiring applicable
  32→  confirmation, not evidence that it is always the latest or correct scale.
  33→- Preserve user-approved five-category causality terminology. Source 634 rapid-
  34→  reporting treatment of “可能无关” and source 639 binary mapping need separate
  35→  disposition; a statistical ADR grouping must not silently become the expedited
  36→  reporting algorithm. Draft-guidance quotation at 635 is not current final law.
  37→- Source 652 mixes consent-to-follow-up collection with pre-dose history-only
  38→  treatment. Define the actual collection periods and handling explicitly; do
  39→  not silently equate AE collection with TEAE classification. Thirty days,
  40→  five half-lives and new anticancer treatment are not universal cutoffs.
  41→- Source 679 allows choosing report time for convenience. Preserve occurrence,
  42→  sampling/assessment, awareness and reporting times separately where relevant;
  43→  do not replace a clinical date simply because tracing it is harder.
  44→- AE terminology and seriousness criteria are separate from treatments/outcomes.
  45→  Follow-up and the clinical handling of ongoing events need actual scope and
  46→  duration; nonempty event labels alone cannot satisfy this contract.
  47→- Source 713 investigator reporting, 723–731 sponsor expedited reporting and
  48→  ethics/institution communications need distinct recipient/timing obligations.
  49→  Source 729 “signed valid report” as day zero must not delay first-awareness
  50→  reporting; previously reviewed ICH E2A III.B is an anchor, while jurisdiction-
  51→  specific implementation still requires the applicable current authority.
  52→- AESI definitions and thresholds (739–747) need product-specific selection;
  53→  aPTT/INR grade 3 and QTc grade 2 are examples, not default AESIs.
  54→- Pregnancy testing, prevention, exposure reporting, partner consent, outcomes
  55→  and abnormal-outcome event reporting are distinct. Source 749's three/six-month
  56→  periods are examples, not a universal rule. Source 750 must not force complete
  57→  study withdrawal merely because treatment is stopped for pregnancy. Follow-up
  58→  and further-data collection require appropriate project-specific arrangements.
  59→
  60→## Fixture distinctions
  61→
  62→Wrong scale/version; missing specimen volume or assay purpose; comparator evidence
  63→used for own-product safety claim; empty monitoring schedule; SAE classified from
  64→severity alone; copied oncology exceptions; signed-form requirement delaying a
  65→report; ADR mapping reused blindly for expedited reporting; pregnancy equated
  66→with SAE or automatic total withdrawal; invented medical or approval receipts.
  67→
  68→Deterministic fixtures can verify declared values, links and contradictions.
  69→They cannot establish medical adequacy, current law or committee approval solely
  70→from a submitted `passed` flag or a document filename.

  74→NCI's current adverse-event page identifies CTCAE v6.0 (2025):
  75→https://dctd.cancer.gov/research/ctep-trials/for-sites/adverse-events
  76→The one-page implementation FAQ (2025-09-09) was read completely:
  77→https://dctd.cancer.gov/research/ctep-trials/for-sites/adverse-events/ctcae-v6-faq.pdf
  78→It distinguishes new-study implementation from ongoing v5.0 studies and provides
  79→a version-mapping resource. Therefore the registry must bind the selected scale
  80→version to the project, not force all existing v5.0 projects to convert or assume
  81→the template's v5.0 is the current release. The FAQ's tentative July2026 Rave
  82→schedule is not verified actual release status and is not used as an activation
  83→condition. This follow-up does not validate individual CTCAE term/grade mappings.
  84→
  85→## Sep8 China-source closure for reporting clocks
  86→
  87→GCP2026 normative text read from official government reproduction; article26
  88→investigator SAE reporting and article44 sponsor assessment/communications checked.
  89→See reviews/mw_protocol_v3_gcp2026_source_check_20260908.md.
  90→For numeric clocks, official Beijing-government-hosted GVP2021 DOC downloaded

  96→Article124: fatal/life-threatening SUSAR first report within7days from first

  98→subsequent new/changed information within15days of obtaining it. Article125 retains

1→"""Canonical Protocol v3 contracts.
   2→
   3→This module is deliberately isolated from the legacy medical-writing models.  It
   4→contains immutable value contracts only; repositories, reducers and API
   5→adapters are introduced by later migration tasks.
   6→"""
   7→
   8→from __future__ import annotations
   9→
  10→from datetime import date, datetime
  11→from enum import Enum
  12→from hashlib import sha256
  13→import json
  14→from typing import Annotated, ClassVar, Literal, Optional, Union
  15→
  16→from typing_extensions import Self
  17→
  18→from pydantic import (
  19→    AfterValidator,
  20→    BaseModel,
  21→    ConfigDict,
  22→    Field,
  23→    JsonValue,
  24→    StringConstraints,
  25→    field_validator,
  26→    model_validator,
  27→    model_serializer,
  28→)
  29→
  30→
  31→PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION = "mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1"
  32→
  33→
  34→def _require_aware_datetime(value: datetime) -> datetime:
  35→    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
  36→        raise ValueError("timestamp must include an explicit timezone")
  37→    return value
  38→
  39→
  40→StableId = Annotated[
  41→    str,
  42→    StringConstraints(
  43→        strip_whitespace=True,
  44→        min_length=3,
  45→        max_length=160,
  46→        pattern=r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[._:-][a-z0-9]+)*$",
  47→    ),
  48→]
  49→Sha256 = Annotated[
  50→    str,
  51→    StringConstraints(pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"),
  52→]
  53→NonEmptyText = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=1)]
  54→AwareDateTime = Annotated[datetime, AfterValidator(_require_aware_datetime)]
  55→UnitInterval = Annotated[float, Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)]
  56→PositiveRevision = Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]
  57→NonNegativeInt = Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)]
  58→
  59→
  60→class CanonicalState(str, Enum):
  61→    RAW = "raw"
  62→    NORMALIZED = "normalized"
  63→    PROPOSED = "proposed"
  64→    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
  65→    FROZEN = "frozen"
  66→    SUPERSEDED = "superseded"
  67→    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
  68→
  69→
  70→_CANONICAL_STATE_TRANSITIONS: dict[CanonicalState, frozenset[CanonicalState]] = {
  71→    CanonicalState.RAW: frozenset(
  72→        {CanonicalState.NORMALIZED, CanonicalState.QUARANTINED}
  73→    ),
  74→    CanonicalState.NORMALIZED: frozenset(
  75→        {CanonicalState.PROPOSED, CanonicalState.QUARANTINED}
  76→    ),
  77→    CanonicalState.PROPOSED: frozenset(
  78→        {
  79→            CanonicalState.CONFIRMED,
  80→            CanonicalState.SUPERSEDED,
  81→            CanonicalState.QUARANTINED,
  82→        }
  83→    ),
  84→    CanonicalState.CONFIRMED: frozenset(
  85→        {
  86→            CanonicalState.FROZEN,
  87→            CanonicalState.SUPERSEDED,
  88→            CanonicalState.QUARANTINED,
  89→        }
  90→    ),
  91→    CanonicalState.FROZEN: frozenset(
  92→        {CanonicalState.SUPERSEDED, CanonicalState.QUARANTINED}
  93→    ),
  94→    CanonicalState.SUPERSEDED: frozenset(),
  95→    CanonicalState.QUARANTINED: frozenset(),
  96→}
  97→
  98→
  99→def assert_canonical_state_transition(
 100→    current: Union[CanonicalState, str],
 101→    target: Union[CanonicalState, str],
 102→) -> CanonicalState:
 103→    """Return the target state when the lifecycle edge is legal.
 104→
 105→    Same-state writes are intentionally not transitions.  Callers that want an
 106→    idempotent no-op should compare the current state before invoking a reducer.
 107→    """
 108→
 109→    current_state = CanonicalState(current)
 110→    target_state = CanonicalState(target)
 111→    if target_state not in _CANONICAL_STATE_TRANSITIONS[current_state]:
 112→        raise ValueError(

 185→def _material_value(value):
 186→    """Serialize model metadata structurally without stripping domain keys."""
 187→
 188→    if isinstance(value, ProtocolV3Model):
 189→        return {
 190→            name: _material_value(getattr(value, name))
 191→            for name in type(value).model_fields
 192→            if name not in ProtocolV3Model.material_metadata_fields
 193→            and not (
 194→                isinstance(value, DependencyBoundModel)
 195→                and name == (
 196→                    "dependency_sha256"
 197→                    if value.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 198→                    else value.dependency_field
 199→                )
 200→            )
 201→        }
 202→    if isinstance(value, dict):
 203→        return {key: _material_value(item) for key, item in value.items()}
 204→    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
 205→        return [_material_value(item) for item in value]
 206→    if isinstance(value, Enum):
 207→        return value.value
 208→    if isinstance(value, (date, datetime)):
 209→        return value.isoformat()
 210→    return value

 213→class ProtocolV3Model(BaseModel):
 214→    """Strict immutable base with stable material hashing."""
 215→
 216→    model_config = ConfigDict(
 217→        extra="forbid",
 218→        frozen=True,
 219→        str_strip_whitespace=True,
 220→        use_enum_values=False,
 221→    )
 222→
 223→    schema_version: Literal["mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1"] = PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 224→
 225→    material_metadata_fields: ClassVar[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
 226→        {
 227→            "canonical_state",
 228→            "created_at",
 229→            "decided_at",
 230→            "display_progress",
 231→            "emitted_at",
 232→            "expected_state_revision",
 233→            "journey_counter",
 234→            "previous_revision_sha256",
 235→            "revision",
 236→            "state_revision",
 237→            "updated_at",
 238→        }
 239→    )
 240→
 241→    def material_payload(self) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
 242→        material = _material_value(self)
 243→        assert isinstance(material, dict)
 244→        return material
 245→
 246→    def material_sha256(self) -> str:
 247→        payload = json.dumps(
 248→            self.material_payload(),
 249→            ensure_ascii=False,
 250→            sort_keys=True,
 251→            separators=(",", ":"),
 252→        ).encode("utf-8")
 253→        return sha256(payload).hexdigest()

 260→class DependencyBoundModel(StatefulProtocolV3Model):
 261→    """Explicit minor-version compaction; legacy payloads and hashes stay intact."""
 262→
 263→    schema_version: Literal["mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1", "mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1_1"] = PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 264→    dependency_field: ClassVar[str]
 265→    dependency_sha256: Optional[Sha256] = None
 266→
 267→    def _dependency_hash(self, hashes: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
 268→        payload = json.dumps(
 269→            {"domain": "mw_protocol_v3_dependencies_v1", "field": self.dependency_field, "hashes": hashes},
 270→            sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
 271→        )
 272→        return sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 273→
 274→    @model_validator(mode="after")
 275→    def validate_dependency_binding(self) -> Self:
 276→        hashes = getattr(self, self.dependency_field)
 277→        _unique(hashes, self.dependency_field)
 278→        if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 279→            if not hashes or self.dependency_sha256 is not None:
 280→                raise ValueError("legacy contracts require dependency hashes and no compact digest")
 281→        else:
 282→            if self.dependency_sha256 is None:
 283→                raise ValueError("compact contracts require a dependency digest")
 284→            if hashes and self._dependency_hash(hashes) != self.dependency_sha256:
 285→                raise ValueError("dependency hashes do not match compact digest")
 286→            object.__setattr__(self, self.dependency_field, ())
 287→        return self
 288→
 289→    @model_serializer(mode="wrap")
 290→    def serialize_dependency_binding(self, handler):
 291→        payload = handler(self)
 292→        payload.pop(
 293→            "dependency_sha256" if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION
 294→            else self.dependency_field, None,
 295→        )
 296→        return payload
 297→
 298→    def compact_dependencies(self) -> Self:
 299→        if self.schema_version != PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 300→            return self
 301→        payload = self.model_dump()
 302→        payload.update(
 303→            schema_version="mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1_1",
 304→            dependency_sha256=self._dependency_hash(getattr(self, self.dependency_field)),
 305→        )
 306→        return type(self).model_validate(payload)
 307→
 308→    def matches_dependencies(self, hashes: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
 309→        if self.schema_version == PROTOCOL_V3_SCHEMA_VERSION:
 310→            return hashes == getattr(self, self.dependency_field)
 311→        return self._dependency_hash(hashes) == self.dependency_sha256

1→"""Read-only stdlib assembly CLI for Task3R.3 batch chapter registries.
   2→
   3→Joins the authored per-node chapter-contract JSON files
   4→(``chapter_contracts/<node_id>.json``), their companion chapter-skill
   5→manifests (``chapter_skills/<node_id>.json``) and a batch fixture/vocabulary
   6→document (closed fact/claim vocabularies, coverage roles, executable
   7→fixtures) into one accepted :class:`ChapterRegistryDocument` shape.  The
   8→chapter JSON files stay the single authored contracts; this helper never
   9→duplicates or rewrites their content.
  10→
  11→Library model validation is mandatory: every contract payload must validate
  12→as :class:`ChapterContractV2`, every skill payload as
  13→:class:`ChapterSkillManifest`, and the assembled document must pass the
  14→fail-closed ``load_chapter_registry`` before it is printed.  Output goes to
  15→stdout only; the CLI performs no writes, no activation and no promotion.
  16→Later batches reuse this same assembly.
  17→
  18→Exit status: 0 success; 2 usage/input failure (unreadable files, schema
  19→mismatch, identity binding failure, or fail-closed registry validation).
  20→"""
  21→
  22→from __future__ import annotations
  23→
  24→import argparse
  25→import json
  26→import sys
  27→from pathlib import Path
  28→
  29→_SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
  30→_REPO_ROOT = _SCRIPT_DIR.parents[2]
  31→for _path in ("services/api", "packages", "."):
  32→    _candidate = _REPO_ROOT / _path
  33→    if str(_candidate) not in sys.path:
  34→        sys.path.insert(0, str(_candidate))
  35→
  36→from packages.contracts.workbench_contracts.protocol_v3 import (  # noqa: E402
  37→    ChapterContractV2,
  38→)
  39→
  40→from app.protocol_workflow.registries.chapters import (  # noqa: E402
  41→    ChapterSkillManifest,
  42→    load_chapter_registry,
  43→)
  44→
  45→BATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION = "protocol-v3-chapter-batch.v1"
  46→REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION = "protocol-v3-chapter-registry.v1"
  47→
  48→_BATCH_REQUIRED_KEYS = (
  49→    "schema_version",
  50→    "generated_for",
  51→    "authority",
  52→    "template_id",
  53→    "template_sha256",
  54→    "fact_vocabulary",
  55→    "claim_vocabulary",
  56→    "coverage_roles",
  57→    "fixtures",
  58→)
  59→
  60→
  61→class AssemblyInputError(ValueError):
  62→    """Raised when the batch inputs are unusable; reported without traceback."""
  63→
  64→
  65→def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
  66→    try:
  67→        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  68→    except OSError as exc:
  69→        raise AssemblyInputError(f"cannot read {path}: {exc}") from exc
  70→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
  71→        raise AssemblyInputError(f"{path} is not valid JSON: {exc}") from exc
  72→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
  73→        raise AssemblyInputError(f"{path} must contain a JSON object")
  74→    return data
  75→
  76→
  77→def _load_batch_document(batch_path: Path) -> dict:
  78→    batch = _read_json(batch_path)
  79→    missing = [key for key in _BATCH_REQUIRED_KEYS if key not in batch]
  80→    if missing:
  81→        raise AssemblyInputError(
  82→            f"{batch_path} is missing batch keys: {missing}"
  83→        )
  84→    if batch["schema_version"] != BATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION:
  85→        raise AssemblyInputError(
  86→            f"{batch_path} schema_version must be {BATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION!r}; "
  87→            f"got {batch['schema_version']!r}"
  88→        )
  89→    if not isinstance(batch["coverage_roles"], dict) or not batch["coverage_roles"]:
  90→        raise AssemblyInputError(
  91→            f"{batch_path} coverage_roles must be a non-empty object"
  92→        )
  93→    for key in ("fact_vocabulary", "claim_vocabulary", "fixtures"):
  94→        if not isinstance(batch[key], list):
  95→            raise AssemblyInputError(f"{batch_path} {key} must be a list")
  96→    return batch
  97→
  98→
  99→def _load_payload_dir(directory: Path, label: str, node_ids: dict) -> dict:
 100→    if not directory.is_dir():
 101→        raise AssemblyInputError(f"{label} directory does not exist: {directory}")
 102→    payloads = {}
 103→    for node_id in sorted(node_ids):
 104→        path = directory / f"{node_id}.json"
 105→        payloads[node_id] = _read_json(path)
 106→    if not payloads:
 107→        raise AssemblyInputError(f"{label} directory has no JSON files: {directory}")
 108→    return payloads
 109→
 110→
 111→def assemble_registry(
 112→    contracts_dir: str | Path,
 113→    skills_dir: str | Path,
 114→    batch_path: str | Path,
 115→) -> dict:
 116→    """Assemble and fail-closed validate one batch registry payload."""
 117→    contracts_dir = Path(contracts_dir)
 118→    skills_dir = Path(skills_dir)
 119→    batch_path = Path(batch_path)
 120→    batch = _load_batch_document(batch_path)
 121→    contract_payloads = _load_payload_dir(contracts_dir, "chapter_contracts", batch["coverage_roles"])
 122→    skill_payloads = _load_payload_dir(skills_dir, "chapter_skills", batch["coverage_roles"])
 123→
 124→    entries = []
 125→    for stem in sorted(contract_payloads):
 126→        contract = ChapterContractV2.model_validate(contract_payloads[stem])
 127→        if contract.semantic_node_id != stem:
 128→            raise AssemblyInputError(
 129→                f"{contracts_dir / stem}.json binds semantic_node_id "
 130→                f"{contract.semantic_node_id!r}; the file name must be the node id"
 131→            )
 132→        if stem not in skill_payloads:
 133→            raise AssemblyInputError(f"no companion skill manifest for {stem!r}")
 134→        skill = ChapterSkillManifest.model_validate(skill_payloads[stem])
 135→        coverage_role = batch["coverage_roles"].get(stem)
 136→        if coverage_role is None:
 137→            raise AssemblyInputError(
 138→                f"{batch_path} declares no coverage role for {stem!r}"
 139→            )
 140→        entries.append(
 141→            {
 142→                "node_id": stem,
 143→                "coverage_role": coverage_role,
 144→                "contract": json.loads(contract.model_dump_json()),
 145→                "skills": [json.loads(skill.model_dump_json())],
 146→            }
 147→        )
 148→
 149→    payload = {
 150→        "schema_version": REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
 151→        "generated_for": batch["generated_for"],
 152→        "authority": batch["authority"],
 153→        "template_id": batch["template_id"],
 154→        "template_sha256": batch["template_sha256"],
 155→        "fact_vocabulary": list(batch["fact_vocabulary"]),
 156→        "claim_vocabulary": list(batch["claim_vocabulary"]),
 157→        "chapters": entries,
 158→        "fixtures": list(batch["fixtures"]),
 159→    }
 160→    load_chapter_registry(payload)
 161→    return payload
 162→
 163→
 164→def assemble_registries(contracts_dir, skills_dir, batch_paths) -> dict:
 165→    """Combine explicit batch slices; never overwrite duplicate chapter identities."""
 166→    documents = [assemble_registry(contracts_dir, skills_dir, path) for path in batch_paths]
 167→    if not documents:
 168→        raise AssemblyInputError("at least one batch is required")
 169→    combined = dict(documents[0])
 170→    for document in documents[1:]:
 171→        if any(document[key] != combined[key] for key in ("template_id", "template_sha256")):
 172→            raise AssemblyInputError("batches refer to different template identities")
 173→    for key in ("generated_for", "authority"):
 174→        combined[key] = "\n".join(dict.fromkeys(document[key] for document in documents))
 175→    for key in ("fact_vocabulary", "claim_vocabulary"):
 176→        combined[key] = sorted({value for document in documents for value in document[key]})
 177→    for key in ("chapters", "fixtures"):
 178→        combined[key] = [value for document in documents for value in document[key]]
 179→    load_chapter_registry(combined)
 180→    return combined
 181→
 182→
 183→def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
 184→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
 185→        prog="assemble_chapter_registry",
 186→        description=(
 187→            "Assemble authored chapter-contract/skill JSON files and a batch "
 188→            "fixture/vocabulary document into a validated chapter registry "
 189→            "printed on stdout (read-only; no writes, activation or promotion)."
 190→        ),
 191→    )
 192→    parser.add_argument("--contracts-dir", required=True)
 193→    parser.add_argument("--skills-dir", required=True)
 194→    parser.add_argument("--batch", required=True, action="append", help="repeat for each batch to include")
 195→    parser.add_argument("--indent", type=int, default=2)
 196→    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
 197→    try:
 198→        payload = assemble_registries(args.contracts_dir, args.skills_dir, args.batch)
 199→    except ValueError as exc:
 200→        print(f"assembly failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
 201→        return 2
 202→    print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=args.indent))
 203→    return 0
 204→
 205→
 206→if __name__ == "__main__":
 207→    raise SystemExit(main())

   4→registries whose chapters embed the accepted :class:`ChapterContractV2`
   5→payloads together with dedicated chapter-skill manifests, a closed fact/claim
   6→vocabulary and executable positive/negative fixtures.  It deliberately does
   7→NOT author clinical chapter content, call any product, or decide medical or

   9→reported separately.

 306→def resolve_schema_ref(ref: str) -> type[BaseModel]:
 307→    """Resolve a ``module:TypeName`` schema ref to the exported Pydantic type."""
 308→    module_name, _, type_name = ref.partition(":")
 309→    if not module_name or not type_name:
 310→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"malformed schema ref: {ref!r}")
 311→    try:
 312→        module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
 313→        resolved = getattr(module, type_name)
 314→    except (ImportError, AttributeError) as exc:
 315→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"schema ref does not resolve: {ref!r}") from exc
 316→    if not (isinstance(resolved, type) and issubclass(resolved, BaseModel)):
 317→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"schema ref is not a Pydantic model: {ref!r}")
 318→    return resolved

 446→class ChapterRegistryDocument(BaseModel):
 447→    """Closed, versioned chapter registry document."""
 448→
 449→    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True, str_strip_whitespace=True)
 450→
 451→    schema_version: Literal[CHAPTER_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION]  # type: ignore[valid-type]
 452→    generated_for: NonEmptyText
 453→    authority: NonEmptyText
 454→    template_id: StableId
 455→    template_sha256: Sha256
 456→    fact_vocabulary: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 457→    claim_vocabulary: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 458→    chapters: tuple[ChapterEntry, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
 459→    fixtures: tuple[ChapterFixture, ...] = ()
 460→
 461→    @field_validator("fact_vocabulary", "claim_vocabulary")
 462→    @classmethod
 463→    def _vocab_closed(
 464→        cls, value: tuple[NonEmptyText, ...], info: Any
 465→    ) -> tuple[NonEmptyText, ...]:
 466→        if len(value) != len(set(value)):
 467→            raise ValueError(f"{info.field_name} must not contain duplicates")
 468→        return value
 469→
 470→    @model_validator(mode="after")
 471→    def _cross_document_identity(self) -> ChapterRegistryDocument:
 472→        node_ids = [entry.node_id for entry in self.chapters]
 473→        if len(node_ids) != len(set(node_ids)):
 474→            duplicates = sorted({nid for nid in node_ids if node_ids.count(nid) > 1})
 475→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate chapter node ids: {duplicates}")
 476→        contract_ids = [entry.contract.chapter_contract_id for entry in self.chapters]
 477→        if len(contract_ids) != len(set(contract_ids)):
 478→            duplicates = sorted({cid for cid in contract_ids if contract_ids.count(cid) > 1})
 479→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate chapter contract ids: {duplicates}")
 480→        skill_ids = [
 481→            skill.skill_id for entry in self.chapters for skill in entry.skills
 482→        ]
 483→        if len(skill_ids) != len(set(skill_ids)):
 484→            duplicates = sorted({sid for sid in skill_ids if skill_ids.count(sid) > 1})
 485→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate skill ids: {duplicates}")
 486→        for entry in self.chapters:
 487→            if entry.contract.template_id != self.template_id:
 488→                raise ValueError(
 489→                    f"chapter {entry.node_id!r} template_id differs from the registry"
 490→                )
 491→            if entry.contract.template_sha256 != self.template_sha256:
 492→                raise ValueError(
 493→                    f"chapter {entry.node_id!r} template_sha256 differs from the registry"
 494→                )
 495→        fixture_ids = [fixture.fixture_id for fixture in self.fixtures]
 496→        if len(fixture_ids) != len(set(fixture_ids)):
 497→            duplicates = sorted({fid for fid in fixture_ids if fixture_ids.count(fid) > 1})
 498→            raise ValueError(f"duplicate fixture ids: {duplicates}")
 499→        declared = set(contract_ids)
 500→        for fixture in self.fixtures:
 501→            if fixture.chapter_contract_id not in declared:
 502→                raise ValueError(
 503→                    f"fixture {fixture.fixture_id!r} binds unknown chapter contract "
 504→                    f"{fixture.chapter_contract_id!r}"
 505→                )
 506→        return self

 509→def _load_json(source: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 510→    if isinstance(source, Mapping):
 511→        return json.loads(json.dumps(dict(source), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
 512→    path = Path(source)
 513→    try:
 514→        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 515→    except OSError as exc:
 516→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"chapter registry unreadable: {path}") from exc
 517→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
 518→        raise ChapterRegistryError(f"chapter registry is not valid JSON: {path}") from exc
 519→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
 520→        raise ChapterRegistryError(
 521→            f"chapter registry must be a JSON object; got {type(data).__name__}"
 522→        )
 523→    return data
 524→
 525→
 526→def load_chapter_registry(
 527→    source: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any],
 528→) -> ChapterRegistryDocument:
 529→    """Load and validate a chapter registry document fail-closed.
 530→
 531→    Raises :class:`ChapterRegistryError` (a ``ValueError``) for any closed-set,
 532→    schema-version, duplicate, identity-binding or vocabulary violation.
 533→    """
 534→    data = _load_json(source)
 535→    _scan_credentials(data, "chapter-registry")
 536→    try:
 537→        document = ChapterRegistryDocument.model_validate(data)
 538→    except ValidationError as exc:
 539→        raise ChapterRegistryError(
 540→            f"chapter registry failed closed: {exc}"
 541→        ) from exc
 542→    return document

 590→
 591→def evaluate_chapter_content(
 592→    contract: ChapterContractV2,
 593→    content: ChapterContentPayload,
 594→    *,
 595→    subject_id: str,
 596→    supplied_passed: Optional[bool] = None,
 597→    supplied_qc_verdict: Optional[str] = None,
 598→) -> FixtureCheckResult:
 599→    """Deterministically check supplied content against a chapter contract.
 600→
 601→    Only shape/positivity/source-floor violations are decided here.  Positive
 602→    QC rules, CtQ items and skeleton-risk rules that require medical judgment
 603→    are returned as ``deferred_qc_obligations`` and are never counted as
 604→    evaluated.  Supplied ``passed`` flags and QC verdict strings are ignored.
 605→    """
 606→    findings: list[CheckerFinding] = []
 607→    substantive = contract.substantive_content
 608→
 609→    facts_by_path = {fact.fact_path: fact for fact in content.facts}
 610→    claims_by_type = {claim.claim_type: claim for claim in content.claims}
 611→
 612→    for index, requirement in enumerate(substantive.fact_requirements):
 613→        location = f"contract.fact_requirements[{index}]({requirement.fact_path})"
 614→        supplied = facts_by_path.get(requirement.fact_path)
 615→        has_value = supplied is not None and bool((supplied.value or "").strip())
 616→        if requirement.obligation.value == "required" and not has_value:
 617→            findings.append(
 618→                _finding(
 619→                    "missing_required_fact",
 620→                    location,
 621→                    "required fact is absent, null or blank; key existence alone "
 622→                    "is insufficient",
 623→                )
 624→            )
 625→        if requirement.obligation.value == "forbidden" and has_value:
 626→            findings.append(
 627→                _finding(
 628→                    "forbidden_fact_present",
 629→                    location,
 630→                    "forbidden fact path carries actual content",
 631→                )
 632→            )
 633→
 634→    for index, requirement in enumerate(substantive.claim_requirements):
 635→        location = f"contract.claim_requirements[{index}]({requirement.claim_type})"
 636→        supplied = claims_by_type.get(requirement.claim_type)
 637→        has_statement = supplied is not None and bool(
 638→            (supplied.statement or "").strip()
 639→        )
 640→        if requirement.obligation.value == "required" and not has_statement:
 641→            findings.append(
 642→                _finding(
 643→                    "missing_required_claim",
 644→                    location,
 645→                    "required claim is absent or its statement is empty",
 646→                )
 647→            )
 648→        if requirement.obligation.value == "forbidden" and has_statement:
 649→            findings.append(
 650→                _finding(
 651→                    "forbidden_claim_present",
 652→                    location,
 653→                    "forbidden claim type carries an actual statement",
 654→                )
 655→            )
 656→        if requirement.obligation.value == "qualified" and has_statement:
 657→            findings.append(
 658→                CheckerFinding(
 659→                    code="qualified_claim_needs_review",
 660→                    severity="info",
 661→                    location=location,
 662→                    message=(
 663→                        "qualified claim present; qualifying conditions require "
 664→                        "medical judgment not executed here"
 665→                    ),
 666→                )
 667→            )
 668→
 669→    requirements = substantive.evidence_source_requirements
 670→    for group_index, group in enumerate(requirements):
 671→        group_location = f"contract.evidence_source_requirements[{group_index}]"
 672→        roles = {role.value for role in group.source_roles}
 673→        admissions = set(group.admission_claim_types)
 674→        locators = {kind.value for kind in group.allowed_locator_kinds}
 675→        conforming = False
 676→        for item_index, item in enumerate(content.evidence):
 677→            item_location = f"{group_location}.supplied[{item_index}]"
 678→            if item.admission_claim_type not in admissions:
 679→                continue
 680→            if item.source_role.value not in roles and any(
 681→                item.source_role in other.source_roles
 682→                and item.admission_claim_type in other.admission_claim_types
 683→                for other in requirements
 684→            ):
 685→                continue
 686→            if item.admission_claim_type in admissions and item.source_role.value not in roles:
 687→                findings.append(
 688→                    _finding(
 689→                        "wrong_source_role",
 690→                        item_location,
 691→                        f"source role {item.source_role.value!r} may not admit "
 692→                        f"claim {item.admission_claim_type!r}",
 693→                    )
 694→                )
 695→            if item.locator_kind.value not in locators:
 696→                findings.append(
 697→                    _finding(
 698→                        "disallowed_locator",
 699→                        item_location,
 700→                        f"locator kind {item.locator_kind.value!r} is not allowed",
 701→                    )
 702→                )
 703→            if group.require_context_window and not (item.context or "").strip():
 704→                findings.append(
 705→                    _finding(
 706→                        "missing_context_window",
 707→                        item_location,
 708→                        "evidence floor requires a non-blank context window",
 709→                    )
 710→                )
 711→            if item.quality_score < group.minimum_quality_score:
 712→                findings.append(
 713→                    _finding(
 714→                        "insufficient_quality",
 715→                        item_location,
 716→                        f"quality score {item.quality_score} is below the floor "
 717→                        f"{group.minimum_quality_score}",
 718→                    )
 719→                )
 720→            if (
 721→                item.source_role.value in roles
 722→                and item.admission_claim_type in admissions
 723→                and item.locator_kind.value in locators
 724→                and (not group.require_context_window or (item.context or "").strip())
 725→                and item.quality_score >= group.minimum_quality_score
 726→            ):
 727→                conforming = True
 728→        if not conforming:
 729→            findings.append(
 730→                _finding(
 731→                    "unsatisfied_evidence_requirement",
 732→                    group_location,
 733→                    "no supplied evidence unit satisfies this evidence floor",
 734→                )
 735→            )
 736→    if requirements:
 737→        declared_admissions = {
 738→            claim for group in requirements for claim in group.admission_claim_types
 739→        }
 740→        declared_roles = {
 741→            role.value for group in requirements for role in group.source_roles
 742→        }
 743→        for item_index, item in enumerate(content.evidence):
 744→            if item.admission_claim_type not in declared_admissions and item.source_role.value in declared_roles:
 745→                findings.append(_finding(
 746→                    "inadmissible_claim", f"content.evidence[{item_index}]",
 747→                    "claim is not admitted by any declared evidence requirement",
 748→                ))
 749→            if (
 750→                item.admission_claim_type not in declared_admissions
 751→                and item.source_role.value not in declared_roles
 752→            ):
 753→                findings.append(
 754→                    CheckerFinding(
 755→                        code="undeclared_evidence_source",
 756→                        severity="warning",
 757→                        location=f"content.evidence[{item_index}]",
 758→                        message="evidence unit maps to no declared evidence floor",
 759→                    )
 760→                )
 761→
 762→    for index, obligation in enumerate(substantive.structural_object_obligations):
 763→        location = (
 764→            f"contract.structural_object_obligations[{index}]"
 765→            f"({obligation.object_kind.value})"
 766→        )
 767→        material = _material_occurrences(content, obligation.object_kind.value)
 768→        if material < obligation.minimum_occurrences:
 769→            findings.append(
 770→                _finding(
 771→                    "missing_structural_object",
 772→                    location,
 773→                    f"material occurrences {material} are below the required "
 774→                    f"{obligation.minimum_occurrences}; ID-only shells do not count",
 775→                )
 776→            )
 777→        supplied_cells = {
 778→            cell.cell_id: cell
 779→            for obj in content.objects
 780→            if obj.object_kind.value == obligation.object_kind.value
 781→            for cell in obj.cells
 782→        }
 783→        for cell_id in obligation.required_object_cells:
 784→            cell = supplied_cells.get(cell_id)
 785→            if cell is None or not (cell.value or "").strip():
 786→                findings.append(
 787→                    _finding(
 788→                        "missing_required_cell",
 789→                        f"{location}.cell({cell_id})",
 790→                        "required cell is absent, null or blank",
 791→                    )
 792→                )
 793→
 794→    required_fact_paths = {
 795→        item.fact_path
 796→        for item in substantive.fact_requirements
 797→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 798→    }
 799→    required_claim_types = {
 800→        item.claim_type
 801→        for item in substantive.claim_requirements
 802→        if item.obligation.value == "required"
 803→    }
 804→    has_any_positive_content = (
 805→        any(
 806→            (fact.value or "").strip()
 807→            for fact in content.facts
 808→            if fact.fact_path in required_fact_paths
 809→        )
 810→        or any(
 811→            (claim.statement or "").strip()
 812→            for claim in content.claims
 813→            if claim.claim_type in required_claim_types
 814→        )
 815→        or any(obj.is_material() for obj in content.objects)
 816→    )
 817→    if not has_any_positive_content:
 818→        findings.append(
 819→            _finding(
 820→                "skeleton_content",
 821→                "content",
 822→                "no required fact value, claim statement or material object is "
 823→                "present; title/skeleton-only output fails",
 824→            )
 825→        )
 826→
 827→    known_fact_paths = {item.fact_path for item in substantive.fact_requirements}
 828→    known_claim_types = {item.claim_type for item in substantive.claim_requirements}
 829→    for index, fact in enumerate(content.facts):
 830→        if fact.fact_path not in known_fact_paths:
 831→            findings.append(
 832→                CheckerFinding(
 833→                    code="undeclared_fact_path",
 834→                    severity="warning",
 835→                    location=f"content.facts[{index}]({fact.fact_path})",
 836→                    message="fact path is not declared by this chapter contract",
 837→                )
 838→            )
 839→    for index, claim in enumerate(content.claims):
 840→        if claim.claim_type not in known_claim_types:
 841→            findings.append(
 842→                CheckerFinding(
 843→                    code="undeclared_claim_type",
 844→                    severity="warning",
 845→                    location=f"content.claims[{index}]({claim.claim_type})",
 846→                    message="claim type is not declared by this chapter contract",
 847→                )
 848→            )
 849→
 850→    deferred: list[str] = ["medical_and_qc_judgment_not_executed"]
 851→    for rule in contract.positive_qc_rules:
 852→        deferred.append(f"positive_qc_rule:{rule.positive_qc_rule_id}: {rule.rule}")
 853→    for item in contract.ctq_items:
 854→        deferred.append(f"ctq:{item.ctq_item_id}: {item.question}")
 855→    for rule in substantive.skeleton_risk_rules:
 856→        deferred.append(f"skeleton_risk_rule: {rule}")
 857→    for rule in contract.conditional_applicability_rules:
 858→        deferred.append(f"conditional_applicability_not_executed:{rule.conditional_applicability_rule_id}")
 859→    for element in substantive.project_specific_elements:
 860→        deferred.append(f"project_specific_element_not_evaluated: {element}")
 861→
 862→    ignored = supplied_passed is not None or supplied_qc_verdict is not None
 863→    return FixtureCheckResult(
 864→        subject_id=subject_id,
 865→        chapter_contract_id=contract.chapter_contract_id,
 866→        passed=not any(f.severity == "error" for f in findings),
 867→        findings=tuple(findings),
 868→        deferred_qc_obligations=tuple(deferred),
 869→        ignored_supplied_verdict=ignored,
 870→    )

 928→def _fixture_matches(contract: ChapterContractV2, fixture: ChapterFixture,
 929→                     result: FixtureCheckResult) -> bool:
 930→    if fixture.fixture_kind == "positive":
 931→        return result.passed
 932→    substantive = contract.substantive_content
 933→    missing: set[str] = set()
 934→    if any(item.obligation.value == "required" for item in substantive.fact_requirements):
 935→        missing.add("missing_required_fact")
 936→    if any(item.obligation.value == "required" for item in substantive.claim_requirements):
 937→        missing.add("missing_required_claim")
 938→    if substantive.evidence_source_requirements:
 939→        missing.add("unsatisfied_evidence_requirement")
 940→    if substantive.structural_object_obligations:
 941→        missing.add("missing_structural_object")
 942→    if any(item.required_object_cells for item in substantive.structural_object_obligations):
 943→        missing.add("missing_required_cell")
 944→    expected = {
 945→        "missing_claim": missing & {"missing_required_claim"},
 946→        "missing_control": missing,
 947→        "wrong_source": {"wrong_source_role", "inadmissible_claim", "disallowed_locator",
 948→                         "missing_context_window", "insufficient_quality"},
 949→        "skeleton": {"skeleton_content", "missing_structural_object", "missing_required_cell"},
 950→    }[fixture.fixture_kind]
 951→    return not result.passed and bool(set(result.error_codes()) & expected)

 996→def _expected_roles_from_template(
 997→    node_tree: Mapping[str, Any],
 998→) -> tuple[dict[str, str], bool]:
 999→    heading_nodes = (node_tree.get("heading_style_tree") or {}).get("nodes") or []
1000→    outlined_nodes = (node_tree.get("outlined_tree") or {}).get("nodes") or []
1001→    heading_leaves = {
1002→        node["id"] for node in heading_nodes if node.get("is_leaf_heading")
1003→    }
1004→    outline_leaves = {node["id"] for node in outlined_nodes if node.get("is_leaf")}
1005→    roles: dict[str, str] = {}
1006→    for node_id in heading_leaves | outline_leaves:
1007→        in_heading = node_id in heading_leaves
1008→        in_outline = node_id in outline_leaves
1009→        if in_heading and in_outline:
1010→            roles[node_id] = "heading_leaf"
1011→        elif in_heading:
1012→            roles[node_id] = "heading_only_aggregation"
1013→        else:
1014→            roles[node_id] = "outline_only_leaf"
1015→    has_front_block = bool(node_tree.get("front_block"))
1016→    return roles, has_front_block
1017→
1018→
1019→def _load_template_inputs(template_dir: str | Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
1020→    directory = Path(template_dir)
1021→    node_tree_path = directory / "node_tree.json"
1022→    template_path = directory / "template.json"
1023→    try:
1024→        node_tree = json.loads(node_tree_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1025→        template = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
1026→    except OSError as exc:
1027→        raise LintInputError(
1028→            f"template directory must contain readable node_tree.json and "
1029→            f"template.json: {directory}"
1030→        ) from exc
1031→    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
1032→        raise LintInputError(f"template input is not valid JSON: {directory}") from exc
1033→    source = template.get("source") or {}
1034→    if not template.get("template_id") or not source.get("sha256"):
1035→        raise LintInputError(
1036→            f"template.json must declare template_id and source.sha256: {template_path}"
1037→        )
1038→    return node_tree, template
1039→
1040→
1041→def lint_registry(
1042→    template_dir: str | Path,
1043→    registry: ChapterRegistryDocument,
1044→    *,
1045→    require_complete: bool = True,
1046→) -> LintReport:
1047→    """Cross-contract lint of a chapter registry against the template.
1048→
1049→    Coverage truth derives from the template ``node_tree.json``: the union of
1050→    heading-tree ``is_leaf_heading`` and outlined-tree ``is_leaf`` leaves plus
1051→    the explicit unheaded cover carrier.  Counts are computed, never
1052→    hardcoded, and ``is_leaf`` on heading-only nodes is never used as
1053→    coverage.
1054→
1055→    Full mode (``require_complete=True``) reports every coverage gap as an
1056→    error.  Partial mode validates the submitted batch but always reports the
1057→    registry incomplete and never represents full acceptance: its status is
1058→    ``"incomplete"`` by construction.
1059→    """
1060→    node_tree, template = _load_template_inputs(template_dir)
1061→    expected_roles, has_front_block = _expected_roles_from_template(node_tree)
1062→    template_id = str(template["template_id"])
1063→    template_sha = str(template["source"]["sha256"])

1159→def _with_complete_fixture_families(payload):
1160→    """Supply actual exercised control fixtures for full-mode synthetic tests.
1161→
1162→    Synthetic project-control evidence is intentionally not medical evidence.
1163→    Existing fixture rows are retained; their positive evidence is populated.
1164→    """
1165→    payload = copy.deepcopy(payload)
1166→    payload["claim_vocabulary"].append("synthetic_document_control")
1167→    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
1168→        contract = entry["contract"]
1169→        substantive = contract["substantive_content"]
1170→        substantive["evidence_source_requirements"] = [{
1171→            "source_roles": ["project_primary"],
1172→            "admission_claim_types": ["synthetic_document_control"],
1173→            "allowed_locator_kinds": ["body"], "require_context_window": True,
1174→            "minimum_quality_score": 0.8,
1175→        }]
1176→        evidence = [{
1177→            "source_role": "project_primary", "admission_claim_type": "synthetic_document_control",
1178→            "locator_kind": "body", "locator": "Synthetic control register, version section",
1179→            "context": "Synthetic test record, not a real approval or clinical source.",
1180→            "quality_score": 1.0,
1181→        }]
1182→        positive = {
1183→            "facts": [{"fact_path": item["fact_path"], "value": "Synthetic document version"}
1184→                      for item in substantive["fact_requirements"] if item["obligation"] == "required"],
1185→            "evidence": evidence,
1186→            "objects": [{"object_kind": item["object_kind"],
1187→                         "occurrences": item["minimum_occurrences"],
1188→                         "text": "Synthetic document-control content",
1189→                         "cells": [{"cell_id": cell, "value": "Synthetic version cell"}
1190→                                   for cell in item.get("required_object_cells", [])]}
1191→                        for item in substantive["structural_object_obligations"]],
1192→        }
1193→        for fixture in payload["fixtures"]:
1194→            if fixture["chapter_contract_id"] == contract["chapter_contract_id"] and fixture["fixture_kind"] == "positive":
1195→                fixture["content"]["evidence"] = copy.deepcopy(evidence)
1196→        missing = copy.deepcopy(positive)
1197→        missing["facts"] = []
1198→        wrong = copy.deepcopy(positive)
1199→        wrong["evidence"][0]["source_role"] = "company_style_only"
1200→        for kind, content in (("positive", positive), ("missing_control", missing),
1201→                              ("wrong_source", wrong), ("skeleton", {})):
1202→            payload["fixtures"].append(_fixture_payload(
1203→                f"fixture:complete:{entry['node_id']}:{kind}",
1204→                contract["chapter_contract_id"], kind, content,
1205→            ))
1206→    return payload

def _fixtures_by_node(document) -> dict[str, dict[str, list]]:
    by_node: dict[str, dict[str, list]] = {}
    for fixture in document.fixtures:
        node_id = next(
            entry.node_id
            for entry in document.chapters
            if entry.contract.chapter_contract_id == fixture.chapter_contract_id
        )
        by_node.setdefault(node_id, {}).setdefault(fixture.fixture_kind, []).append(
            fixture
        )
    return by_node


def _fixture(document, node_id: str, suffix: str):
    contract_id = f"contract:{node_id.replace('_', '-')}:v2"
    matches = [
        fixture
        for fixture in document.fixtures
        if fixture.chapter_contract_id == contract_id
        and fixture.fixture_id.endswith(f":{suffix}")
    ]
    assert len(matches) == 1, (node_id, suffix, [f.fixture_id for f in matches])
    return matches[0]

def test_contract_and_skill_files_exist_with_exact_identities():
    # Superset, not equality: other batches author into the same directories
    # concurrently; the selected-batch exactly-19 guarantee is asserted by the
    # assembly tests below.
    assert set(EXPECTED_CARRIERS) <= {p.stem for p in CONTRACTS_DIR.glob("*.json")}
    assert set(EXPECTED_CARRIERS) <= {p.stem for p in SKILLS_DIR.glob("*.json")}
    for stem in EXPECTED_CARRIERS:
        contract = ChapterContractV2.model_validate(
            json.loads((CONTRACTS_DIR / f"{stem}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        )
        assert contract.semantic_node_id == stem
        assert contract.chapter_contract_id == f"contract:{stem.replace('_', '-')}:v2"
        assert contract.template_id == TEMPLATE_ID
        assert contract.template_sha256 == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract.canonical_state.value == "frozen"
        assert contract.chapter_skill_version == contract.contract_version
        skill = json.loads((SKILLS_DIR / f"{stem}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert skill["node_id"] == stem
        assert skill["chapter_contract_id"] == contract.chapter_contract_id
        assert skill["skill_id"] == contract.chapter_skill_id
        assert skill["skill_version"] == contract.chapter_skill_version
        assert skill["template_id"] == TEMPLATE_ID
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        # Skill prompts are node-specific content instructions, not transport.
        assert "provider" not in skill and "model" not in skill
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == (
            "app.protocol_workflow.registries.chapters:ChapterSkillInput"
        )
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == (
            "app.protocol_workflow.registries.chapters:ChapterSkillOutput"
        )
        # Provenance binds the accepted template identity and the exact source
        # window this carrier is derived from.
        first, last = SOURCE_WINDOWS[stem]
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert TEMPLATE_SHA256 in provenance, stem
        assert str(first) in provenance and str(last) in provenance, stem
        assert "batch5" in provenance, stem

def test_every_fixture_exercises_its_named_defect(registry_document):
    by_node = _fixtures_by_node(registry_document)
    assert set(by_node) == set(EXPECTED_CARRIERS)
    total = 0
    for node_id, kinds in by_node.items():
        expected_kind, expected_code = NAMED_NEGATIVES[node_id]
        # Every positive must pass; no negative may pass.
        for fixture in kinds.get("positive", []):
            result = check_fixture(registry_document, fixture)
            assert result.passed is True, (node_id, fixture.fixture_id)
            assert not _error_codes(result)
            # A deterministic pass never claims medical/QC judgment happened.
            assert result.deferred_qc_obligations
        named = _fixture(
            registry_document, node_id, expected_kind.replace("_", "-")
        )
        named_result = check_fixture(registry_document, named)
        assert named_result.passed is False, node_id
        assert expected_code in _error_codes(named_result), node_id
        if node_id in MISSING_FAMILY_CODES:
            missing = _fixture(
                registry_document,
                node_id,
                MISSING_FAMILY[node_id].replace("_", "-"),
            )
            missing_result = check_fixture(registry_document, missing)
            assert missing_result.passed is False, node_id
            assert MISSING_FAMILY_CODES[node_id] in _error_codes(missing_result), node_id
        wrong = _fixture(registry_document, node_id, "wrong-source")
        assert "wrong_source_role" in _error_codes(
            check_fixture(registry_document, wrong)
        ), node_id
        skeleton = _fixture(registry_document, node_id, "skeleton")
        assert "skeleton_content" in _error_codes(
            check_fixture(registry_document, skeleton)
        ), node_id
        for kind, fixtures in kinds.items():
            if kind == "positive":
                continue
            for fixture in fixtures:
                result = check_fixture(registry_document, fixture)
                assert result.passed is False, (node_id, fixture.fixture_id)
        # Spec-required families plus the source-specific negatives.
        assert {"positive", "wrong_source", "skeleton"} <= set(kinds), node_id
        assert kinds.get("missing_claim") or kinds.get("missing_control"), node_id
        total += sum(len(items) for items in kinds.values())
    # 19 nodes x at least 4 families; the spec's source-specific negatives push
    # the authored total above the four-per-node floor of 76.
    assert total >= 76
    assert total == len(registry_document.fixtures)

def test_parent_body_obligations_are_inherited_with_declared_markers(registry_document):
    """The parent chapters/areas are not carriers; their framing obligations are
    carried by named leaves with an honest declared-addition marker."""
    for node_id, (parent_id, fact_path) in INHERITED_PARENT_BODY.items():
        contract = _contract(node_id)
        assert fact_path in _required_facts(contract), (node_id, fact_path)
        requirement = next(
            item
            for item in contract.substantive_content.fact_requirements
            if item.fact_path == fact_path
        )
        assert "继承声明" in requirement.rationale, node_id
        assert parent_id in requirement.rationale, node_id
        elements = " ".join(contract.substantive_content.project_specific_elements)
        assert "继承声明" in elements and parent_id in elements, node_id
    # No contract claims a nonexistent leaf identity.
    for entry in registry_document.chapters:

        assert entry.node_id not in PARENT_NODES

    """Batch2/batch4 fact bindings are referenced where the meaning matches;
    no second editable store is created for the same meaning."""
    expected_reuse = {
        "v2_n_9_1": {
            "picos.primary_objectives",
            "picos.primary_endpoint",

        "v2_n_9_3": {

        },
        "v2_n_10_5": {"picos.aesi_definitions"},
        "v2_n_10_6": {"discontinuation.continued_assessment_scope"},
    }
    for node_id, paths in expected_reuse.items():
        contract = _contract(node_id)

        }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lint: partial batch is clean but incomplete; full mode fails on the rest.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_partial_lint_is_clean_but_never_complete(registry_document):
    report = lint_registry(REAL_TEMPLATE_DIR, registry_document, require_complete=False)
    assert report.mode == "partial"
    assert report.status == "incomplete"
    assert report.errors() == ()
    codes = {f.code for f in report.findings}
    assert "partial_mode_not_full_acceptance" in codes
    assert not codes & {
        "unknown_fact_path",
        "unknown_claim_type",
        "conditional_forbidden_conflict",
        "dangling_ctq_anchor",
        "coverage_role_mismatch",
        "unexpected_carrier",
        "skill_not_bound",
        "fixture_expectation_mismatch",
        "dangling_dependency",
        "missing_coverage",
    }
    assert report.coverage.covered_carrier_count == 19
    # Batch scope only: other batches' carriers must show up as missing and
    # their files must not leak into this slice.
    for node_id in ("v2_n_1_1", "v2_n_3_1_1", "v2_n_8_2", "v2_n_16_x1"):
        assert node_id in report.coverage.missing_node_ids, node_id
    assert len(report.fixture_results) == len(registry_document.fixtures)


def test_full_lint_fails_on_remaining_coverage(registry_document):
    report = lint_registry(REAL_TEMPLATE_DIR, registry_document, require_complete=True)
    assert report.mode == "full"
    assert report.status == "incomplete"
    missing = [f for f in report.errors() if f.code == "missing_coverage"]
    assert report.coverage.expected_carrier_count == 111  # 110 leaf union + cover
    assert len(missing) == report.coverage.expected_carrier_count - 19
    missing_ids = {f.node_id for f in missing}
    assert not missing_ids & set(EXPECTED_CARRIERS)
    assert {"v2_n_1_1", "v2_n_3_1_1", "v2_n_8_2", "v2_n_16_x1"} <= missing_ids

def test_assembly_cli_stdout_only_readonly_and_lint_cli_roundtrip(tmp_path):

    }
    result = subprocess.run(

    assert "INCOMPLETE" in lint_result.stdout

def build_positive(node_id, contract):
    first,last=WINDOWS[node_id]
    substantive=contract["substantive_content"]
    facts=[]
    for req in substantive["fact_requirements"]:
        if req["obligation"]!="required": continue
        path=req["fact_path"]
        if path.endswith("_applicable") or path.endswith(".applicable"):
            value="false"
        else:
            value=FACT_VALUE_OVERRIDES.get(path, SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u503c\uff1a%s\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff0c\u975e\u771f\u5b9e\u9879\u76ee\u4e8b\u5b9e\uff09\u3002"%path)
        facts.append({"fact_path":path,"value":value})
    claims=[]
    for req in substantive["claim_requirements"]:
        if req["obligation"]!="required": continue
        claims.append({"claim_type":req["claim_type"],
                       "statement":SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u58f0\u660e\uff1a%s\uff08\u6ee1\u8db3\u5408\u540c\u4e49\u52a1\uff0c\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%req["claim_type"]})
    evidence=[]
    for g in substantive["evidence_source_requirements"]:
        evidence.append({"source_role":g["source_roles"][0],
                         "admission_claim_type":g["admission_claim_types"][0],
                         "locator_kind":"body",
                         "locator":SYN+"\u6765\u6e90\u767b\u8bb0\uff1aTP-MA-07 v2.0 body[%d..%d]\uff08\u96f6\u57fa body-child \u7d22\u5f15\uff1b\u5408\u6210\u5939\u5177\uff0c\u975e\u771f\u5b9e\u9879\u76ee\u6279\u51c6\uff09\u3002"%(first,last),
                         "context":SYN+"\u4e0a\u4e0b\u6587\u7a97\u53e3\uff1a%s \u5408\u540c\u4e49\u52a1\u5bf9\u5e94\u6e90\u4e0a\u4e0b\u6587\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%node_id,
                         "quality_score":0.95})
    objects=[]
    for ob in substantive["structural_object_obligations"]:
        entry={"object_kind":ob["object_kind"],"occurrences":ob["minimum_occurrences"]}
        if ob["object_kind"]=="paragraph":
            entry["text"]=SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u6b63\u6587\u6bb5\uff1a%s\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%node_id

            entry["cells"]=[{"cell_id":cell,

                            for cell in ob["required_object_cells"]]
        objects.append(entry)
    return {"facts":facts,"claims":claims,"evidence":evidence,"objects":objects}

def apply_ops(content, ops):
    content=json.loads(json.dumps(content))
    if ops.get("drop_claims"):
        content["claims"]=[]
    for path in ops.get("drop_facts",[]):
        content["facts"]=[f for f in content["facts"] if f["fact_path"]!=path]
    for path,value in ops.get("add_facts",[]):
        content["facts"]=[f for f in content["facts"] if f["fact_path"]!=path]
        content["facts"].append({"fact_path":path,"value":value})
    for ctype,statement in ops.get("add_claims",[]):
        content["claims"]=[c for c in content["claims"] if c["claim_type"]!=ctype]
        content["claims"].append({"claim_type":ctype,"statement":statement})
    for cell in ops.get("blank_cells",[]):
        for o in content["objects"]:
            for c in o.get("cells",[]):
                if c["cell_id"]==cell: c["value"]=None
    if ops.get("drop_objects"):
        content["objects"]=[]
    roles=ops.get("evidence_roles",{})
    if roles:
        for item in content["evidence"]:
            if item["admission_claim_type"] in roles:
                item["source_role"]=roles[item["admission_claim_type"]]
    if ops.get("wrong_source"):
        for item in content["evidence"]:
            item["source_role"]="company_style_only"
    return content

def build_positive(node_id, contract):
    first,last=WINDOWS[node_id]
    substantive=contract["substantive_content"]
    facts=[]
    for req in substantive["fact_requirements"]:
        if req["obligation"]!="required": continue
        path=req["fact_path"]
        if path.endswith("_applicable") or path.endswith(".applicable"):
            value="false"
        else:
            value=FACT_VALUE_OVERRIDES.get(path, SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u503c\uff1a%s\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff0c\u975e\u771f\u5b9e\u9879\u76ee\u4e8b\u5b9e\uff09\u3002"%path)
        facts.append({"fact_path":path,"value":value})
    claims=[]
    for req in substantive["claim_requirements"]:
        if req["obligation"]!="required": continue
        claims.append({"claim_type":req["claim_type"],
                       "statement":SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u58f0\u660e\uff1a%s\uff08\u6ee1\u8db3\u5408\u540c\u4e49\u52a1\uff0c\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%req["claim_type"]})
    evidence=[]
    for g in substantive["evidence_source_requirements"]:
        evidence.append({"source_role":g["source_roles"][0],
                         "admission_claim_type":g["admission_claim_types"][0],
                         "locator_kind":"body",
                         "locator":SYN+"\u6765\u6e90\u767b\u8bb0\uff1aTP-MA-07 v2.0 body[%d..%d]\uff08\u96f6\u57fa body-child \u7d22\u5f15\uff1b\u5408\u6210\u5939\u5177\uff0c\u975e\u771f\u5b9e\u9879\u76ee\u6279\u51c6\uff09\u3002"%(first,last),
                         "context":SYN+"\u4e0a\u4e0b\u6587\u7a97\u53e3\uff1a%s \u5408\u540c\u4e49\u52a1\u5bf9\u5e94\u6e90\u4e0a\u4e0b\u6587\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%node_id,
                         "quality_score":0.95})
    objects=[]
    for ob in substantive["structural_object_obligations"]:
        entry={"object_kind":ob["object_kind"],"occurrences":ob["minimum_occurrences"]}
        if ob["object_kind"]=="paragraph":
            entry["text"]=SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u6b63\u6587\u6bb5\uff1a%s\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%node_id
        else:
            entry["cells"]=[{"cell_id":cell,
                             "value":CELL_VALUE_OVERRIDES.get(cell,SYN+"\u5408\u6210\u5355\u5143\u683c\u503c\uff1a%s\uff08\u6d4b\u8bd5\u7528\uff09\u3002"%cell)}
                            for cell in ob["required_object_cells"]]
        objects.append(entry)
    return {"facts":facts,"claims":claims,"evidence":evidence,"objects":objects}

def apply_ops(content, ops):
    content=json.loads(json.dumps(content))
    if ops.get("drop_claims"):
        content["claims"]=[]
    for path in ops.get("drop_facts",[]):
        content["facts"]=[f for f in content["facts"] if f["fact_path"]!=path]
    for path,value in ops.get("add_facts",[]):
        content["facts"]=[f for f in content["facts"] if f["fact_path"]!=path]
        content["facts"].append({"fact_path":path,"value":value})
